items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I was there I think for six weeks, and Vido Musso was on the band

ctx.x: And I remember taking Cootie Williams’ place with Benny Goodman at the New Yorker Hotel. I was there I think for six weeks, and Vido Musso was on the band, Hymie Schertzer was playing lead, Brad McGowan on valve trombone. It was really a good band. But I didn’t care about anything. I had heard about “the ray” and things like that, how he used to think. But I remember the night before we opened up, Guy Lombardo’s band was there, and I was kind of snickering a little bit because it was Muzak compared to where I was…
